# Maps an FFM struct layout constant to the C type it mirrors, so the audit can compare its size
# and every named field's offset against the real header. A layout with no entry here is reported
# as unmapped and is not checked -- adding a line is the act of claiming which struct it models,
# which is the review step this file exists to force.
# Format: <JAVA_LAYOUT_CONSTANT> = <C type expression>, or <File.NAME> when the name is not unique.

# -- kstat.h
KSTAT_LAYOUT       = kstat_t
KSTAT_NAMED_LAYOUT = kstat_named_t
KSTAT_IO_LAYOUT    = kstat_io_t

# -- utmpx.h, sys/resource.h, cups/cups.h
SolarisLibcFunctions.UTMPX_LAYOUT = struct utmpx
RLIMIT_LAYOUT                     = struct rlimit
CUPS_DEST_T                       = cups_dest_t
